name: Nimbus
author: hoaxpoet
description: A single coherent mass of glowing cool gas in a black void that moves with the music — a single-pass volumetric single-scatter march. The band plays the body: drums punch and brighten the whole mass, bass/lead/other heave it down/up/sideways, broadband energy blooms it bigger and brighter and flows the gas faster, and mood shifts its color cool↔warm. First volumetric-family preset.
caption: A single mass of glowing cool gas in a black void. The beat punches through it, the music's overall energy brightens the whole body, and bass, lead and the rest of the mix heave it down, up and sideways. As the music fills out the mass blooms bigger and brighter and the gas flows faster.
